The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of XML and XSLT in a workflow management system allows for the separation of the workflow logic from the workflow presentation, and for the reuse of existing XML tools and technologies.
the workflow management paradigm is a powerful tool for managing the dynamic nature of computational lexicons and the collaborative process of their construction and maintenance.
